status: confirmed at head 8bed788 (Mohamad Khalil-Yossif); WHO linkage established, PSEA conformance not established, kid-to-principal mapping supplied not derived
note: Single source for the join_who table. `principal_resolution` is the fully enrolled table; two AAE-side identifiers may map onto one canonical principal, which is what xp-6 exercises. `states` names the relying-party enrollment states a vector may be evaluated in; each derives from the enrolled table by omitting the secondary entries it has not enrolled yet. tools/build_interop_psea.py reads both and embeds the derived table into every vector's input.join_who, so no derivation lives as a literal in code and the vectors cannot drift from this file.
unresolved_rule: an identifier with no entry in the table is unresolved

enrolled.note: The relying party has enrolled every signer key in the fixture. This is the default state; a vector that does not name a resolution_state is evaluated in it, and its join_who carries no resolution_state field.

pending_enrollment.note: The relying party has not yet enrolled the key bound to principal-A, so that binding does not resolve on the secondary side. Nothing about the artifacts differs from the enrolled state - only what the relying party knows. Used by xp-5a; xp-5b is the same artifacts evaluated after enrollment.
